inputs.text: Listen, the Punjab and Haryana High Court just granted regular bail to this guy who was held under national security laws and the Official Secrets Act. They're claiming mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with someone in Pakistan isn't enough to detain him, and it was supposedly just telephonic contact with that Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri.” But this is clearly the elites and institutions working together in the shadows to downplay genuine threats and protect their hidden channels from any real exposure. They're twisting the courts to flip the whole thing into supposed overreach, all to shield the coordinated interests that actually run these operations.
